seeds.extensionCondition: ordinary-ai-off pre-effect first-completion count below 300 for any assigned chain; never use win rates to decide extension

engine.end: playPolicyGame stops when seat 0 dies, at most one seat alive, or round 12; then original winnerId settlement
engine.otherRules: original CFG, roles, night rules, item decks, AI personality and base RNG calls unchanged

ordinaryH1.seats1to3: original AI and original random role selection

ordinaryH9.seats1to3: original AI and original random role selection
ordinaryH9.zeroEffectDefinition: delete only that CHAINS entry's flags, traits, hooks and army; keep id, recipe and aiBonus
ordinaryH9.holderDenominator: for each arm separately, games where any of four seats ever acquired the complete specified recipe
ordinaryH9.holderNumerator: winnerId belongs to that arm's holder set

destinyGame.seat0Policy: destiny-chaser-v1: read only own assigned destiny; use createEyesPolicy(informed) for eyes and otherwise createChaser(target-chaser-v1, assigned chain); same policy in every destiny arm
informationLivenessChecks: eyes informed policy receives its own legal preview and prior second bid
ordinary eyes sees three previews while true eyes sees four
informedVsBlindDiff is reported and cannot be silently zero from missing context
destinyGame.seats1to3: original AI with aiDestinyBonus factor only
destinyGame.destinyDraw: four independent secure private draws per seed, recorded once and reused across all six arms; never derived from public game seed

checkpointCohort.phase: first actual auction insertion that completes that seat's assigned recipe, before applying any true effect
checkpointCohort.fork: exact full game state, object identity and RNG state; same seat, same future legal policy
checkpointCohort.focusSeat: the seat whose assigned recipe just completed; evaluate this seat's terminal winner indicator
checkpointCohort.effectToggle: enable the focus seat's assigned true chain only in the treatment fork; its true effect is off in control; all other seats' true effects are off in both forks
checkpointCohort.missingForkResult: incomplete, never a post-treatment holder comparison
